newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO to award July LSWR at $17.55/B to Ssangyong.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO to award July LSWR at $17.55/B to Ssangyong.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Company (KEPCO) is expected to award a tender for a low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) cargo to South Korea's Ssangyong Corp at $17.55 per barrel on Monday, a KEPCO source said on Thursday.
"We have decided to award the tender to Ssangyong and will annouce the result on Monday," the source said, noting the three-day validity of the tender which closed on Thursday.
The cargo will be for July 18-22 delivery to the ports of Ulsan or Pusan on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis..
KEPCO last bought 1.2 million barrels of LSWR at $17.70 and $18.25 per barrel for June delivery on a c-and-f basis.
